description: Returns a normalized, source-linked comparison of selected Orange County, CA barbershops. Use when: the user wants to compare two or more search results on city, published services, availability class, or published handoff capabilities. Do not use when: the user needs beauty categories beyond barbershops, results outside Orange County, guaranteed real-time slots or prices, payment, or a completed booking.

business_ids.description: Required array or comma-separated list of at least two stable business IDs returned by search.

criteria.description: Optional array or comma-separated list of comparison fields: city, services, availability_class, capabilities.

name: compare
title: Compare Barbershops
